title: Finalize backup/restore Confluence runbooks + customer-facing guide for Private deployments
creator: Talia Benson
project: Private Day-2 Ops: Backup/Restore + DR Toolkit
description:
We need to ship a supported, repeatable Day-2 backup/restore + DR story for Redwood Private (VPC + on-prem/air-gapped). This ticket finalizes (1) internal Confluence runbooks used by SRE/Solutions/Support and (2) a customer-facing structured guide that publishes via the docs site tooling.

Scope includes: clear prerequisites, supported storage backends, what’s included/excluded, deterministic restore ordering, validation/smoke tests, failure modes + troubleshooting, and explicit support boundaries. Content must align with the installer CLI UX (backup create / restore apply), Helm/Terraform hooks, envelope encryption behavior, and observability signals.

Primary stakeholders: Vivek Kulkarni (requirements/commitments), Sean Gallagher + Neha Kapoor (runbooks/on-call readiness), Marcus Lin + Hanae Suzuki (encryption/secrets guidance), Connor O’Brien (release packaging + version compatibility), Markus Klein / Fatima Noor / Colin O’Donnell (customer workflows for VPC and on-prem).
acceptance_criteria:
Internal (Confluence)
- Runbook: control-plane backup is step-by-step and includes pre-flight checks, quiesce guidance, artifact verification, and storage backend examples.
- Runbook: control-plane restore covers restore prerequisites, bootstrap ordering, abort/rollback criteria, and post-restore validation (health + functional checks).
- DR plans exist for (a) VPC single-region restore-to-clean-cluster and (b) on-prem/air-gapped restore flow with offline artifact handling.
- SRE smoke test runbook references concrete commands, expected timings, and paging/alert thresholds.

External (Docs site)
- Customer guide is publishable and includes: overview, supported versions/compatibility notes, backup frequency/retention guidance, how to run backup + verify, how to run restore + validate, and DR checklists.
- Troubleshooting section covers top issues seen in staging + early customers (RBAC permissions denied, missing CRDs/ordering, slow object storage timeouts, clock skew, KMS unavailable).
- Explicit statements about secret material: what is backed up (references/metadata) vs what is NOT backed up (raw secret contents) and what customers must provide during restore.
- Links and terminology match product surfaces: installer CLI flags, Helm values, Terraform modules, and metrics names.

Release readiness
- Docs content is versioned or clearly labeled with minimum supported Private version and backup format version.
- Security reviewed sections (encryption, key handling, audit log retention pointers) have sign-off from Security Eng (Marcus/Hanae).
- Support enablement: add a short “Support boundaries” section and escalation checklist (what logs/artifacts to request).
